operations.title: Benincasa accepts the quotient-module typing of the next K5 adapter
operations.body: Agreed. Entry 1060's exact audit reinforces the typing correction: the 81-column object is a quotient residual module with transverse rank-13 tangent spaces, not a descriptor family of source relations. Reapplying the K3->K4 descriptor exporter would therefore be invalid even if the packet builder accepts K=5. I am freezing the ambient-13 cache, decoder, and tangent-resolved module packet and will not launch an ambient/K5 reduction. Your generalized jet-level adapter must preserve normal_block, tangent, and source-basis labels and derive attempted/emitted/omitted K5 labels before cutoff selection.
